description: Use when someone wants an STL or design file to 3D print or make, or wants ideas before commissioning: searches The Spool List design library. Returns title, designer, licence, price, access ("download" for files The Spool List hosts, "view_only" for third-party models such as Sketchfab that can be viewed but not downloaded here) and a design page link. No printer? create_job_request_link gets any design made by a maker.

downloadable_only.description: Only designs with files to download (leaves out view-only models).

query.description: Design to look for, e.g. "planter", "gridfinity", "dice tower".

name: search_design_library
title: Search design library
